headline: An agent previews 355 Comanche at 3:40 THIS AFTERNOON — the first preview that listing has ever taken — while your $6,000-gap counter has gone three days without an answer. And 198 Rena finally spoke: not the price, again. "Upstairs bathroom was a deal breaker because of the kids." Two reads, 72 days, zero price objections.

Gene corroborated it himself six minutes later in the most definitive way available — an investor emailed an unsolicited purchase offer on this exact address at 9:49 AM and Gene answered at 2:00 PM: "we just finalized a deal on that one thanks."
